demo_mcp_servers.name: Vulnerable Runner
demo_mcp_servers.tagline: Planted Command Injection, Hardcoded AWS Secrets & Insecure Deserialization
demo_mcp_servers.description: Exposes MCP tools with intentional vulnerabilities: subprocess shell=True command execution, hardcoded AWS keys, untrusted pickle deserialization, and AST claim-vs-code mismatch.

demo_highlights.title: Command Injection (CWE-78 / Bandit B602)
demo_highlights.desc: subprocess.run(cmd, shell=True) executes raw unsanitized shell commands.

demo_highlights.title: Hardcoded AWS Secret (CWE-798 / Bandit B105)
demo_highlights.desc: Embedded AWS access key 'AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLETESTKEY123' in source.

demo_highlights.title: Insecure Deserialization (CWE-502 / Bandit B301)
demo_highlights.desc: pickle.loads() deserializes untrusted bytes causing arbitrary remote code execution.

demo_highlights.title: Claim-vs-Code Mismatch (CWE-272)
demo_highlights.desc: 'inspect_logs' declared as read-only executes destructive os.remove().

demo_highlights.title: SSRF Vulnerability (CWE-918 / Bandit B310)
demo_highlights.desc: Unrestricted urllib.request.urlopen() permitting file:// and internal metadata fetches.

demo_highlights.title: Insecure Temp File (CWE-377 / Bandit B108)
demo_highlights.desc: Hardcoded /tmp file creation vulnerable to symlink race conditions.
